name: Guruprasath Gopal

answers.scope: Internship applications: placement is not credit-bearing; no academic-credit or school-credit requirement should be claimed.

answers.value: Any (on-site, hybrid or remote) within Singapore

intro: I’m Guru, an NUS-ISS MTech Software Engineering student. I’ve built AWS data and observability pipelines at BugRaid AI, and projects spanning AI agents, health analytics and full-stack applications. I’m looking for a Singapore software, AI or data engineering internship where I can own a useful piece of a real system.
logistics: I can start immediately. My MTech runs to August 2027. My internship is non-credit-bearing; I’m on a Student Pass and require EP sponsorship. Which internship route and pass requirements apply to this team?

practice.title: BugRaid: a reliable ingestion pipeline
practice.situation: Metrics, events, logs and traces came from several systems.
practice.action: Designed ingestion and transformation from SigNoz, S3, Loki, Prometheus and custom sources; deployed containerised services through ECR to ECS.
practice.result: Explain how you handled schema variation, duplicate data, failures and autoscaling. Use only outcomes you can substantiate.
practice.question: What happens when an upstream source is late, malformed or replayed?

practice.title: TalkToIt: private health analytics
practice.situation: Apple Health imports needed efficient processing and usable queries.
practice.action: Used memory-mapped XML scanning, parallel processing, Parquet and DuckDB, with coverage checks and staged database activation.
practice.result: Connect the design to keeping raw records local and making provider failures survivable.
practice.question: How did you verify that a faster import still preserved coverage and correctness?

practice.title: ResearchAgent: bounded agent decisions
practice.situation: Evidence gathering and payment investigation needed clear boundaries.
practice.action: Combined deterministic transaction analysis, BM25 retrieval, function calling, grounded citations and a no-LLM fallback.
practice.result: Explain budget enforcement, source allowlists and when the system declines to buy or infer.
practice.question: Which controls live on the server rather than relying on the model to follow a prompt?

practice.title: Primech: deployment and maintainability
practice.situation: A personnel app had manual deployment and a legacy codebase.
practice.action: Added GitHub Actions workflows and runbooks, documented APIs and architecture, and improved UX.
practice.result: The current master records deployment time falling from 20 minutes to 3 minutes. Explain the baseline and your own contribution.
practice.question: What would you roll back first if deployment succeeded but the app failed?
